Class MuratAmbientLight

java.lang.Object
net.murat.light.MuratAmbientLight
All Implemented Interfaces:
Light
public class MuratAmbientLight extends Object implements Light
Represents an ambient light source providing uniform background illumination. Fully updated to use primitive packed ARGB integers for zero-allocation performance. Compatible with Java 6-8 without lambdas.
